title: Llegó Nimbus 2.0
caption: Nimbus 2.0 ya está disponible. Tres cambios que se notan desde el primer día: velocidad, colaboración y exportación en un clic. ¿Cuál te importa más?

<style id="slide-css">
  /* Copiar este bloque completo como "style" del spec. */
  :root {
    --bg: var(--brand-bg, #EEF2FF);
    --card: #FFFFFF;
    --primary: var(--brand-primary, #4F46E5);
    --dark: var(--brand-dark, #1E1B4B);
    --text: var(--brand-text, #111827);
    --text-dim: var(--brand-text-dim, #6B7280);
    --accent: var(--brand-accent, #F97316);
  }
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  .slide {
    font-family: Outfit, sans-serif;
    flex: 0 0 1080px;
    width: 1080px;
    height: 1350px;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 88px 80px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .top-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 56px;
  }
  .pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 16px 28px;
    background: var(--dark);
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 22px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .pill .dot {
    width: 12px; height: 12px;
    background: var(--primary);
    border-radius: 50%;
  }
  .meta {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-dim);
  }
  .card {
    background: var(--card);
    border-radius: 48px;
    padding: 80px 72px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px color-mix(in srgb, var(--dark) 8%, transparent), 0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--dark) 4%, transparent);
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .eyebrow {
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--primary);
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }
  .headline {
    font-size: 96px;
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em;
    color: var(--dark);
  }
  .subhead {
    font-size: 36px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    margin-top: 32px;
  }
  .stat {
    font-size: 220px;
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.05em;
    color: var(--primary);
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .stat-label {
    font-size: 60px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.1;
    color: var(--dark);
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  }
  .stat-desc {
    font-size: 32px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    margin-top: 24px;
  }
  .footer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-top: 48px;
    padding: 0 16px;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .handle { color: var(--text-dim); }
  .pages { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700; }
  .swipe {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    color: var(--accent);
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .cta-card {
    background: var(--primary);
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .cta-card .eyebrow { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); }
  .cta-card .headline { color: #fff; }
  .cta-card .subhead { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); }
